units.function: Broad managed install/uninstall tests for npm/Git sources, full-SHA resolution, build packaging, provenance, service safety, user-data preservation, symlink defenses and store locking.
units.dependencyDirection: Runs install/uninstall orchestration with a mocked command runner against real temporary filesystem state and install-store primitives.
units.keyDataModels: npm channel/version, Git repo/ref/full SHA, payload path/version, install manifest/history, shim, service unit, lock and user instance data.
units.lifecycle: Resolves source, downloads/builds/packages or reuses payload, flips current/writes manifest/shim, then uninstalls only after service and store verification while retaining user data.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 16/16. Consent, full-SHA provenance, environment isolation, symlink/unverified-store/lock and user-data tests are strong; content signatures/digests, SBOM/license/vulnerability policy, stderr redaction, migration/service-health rollback and privilege boundaries are missing.
units.designRationale: Provide reproducible source-aware self-updates with safe multi-instance service teardown and no user-data deletion.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS self-hosted deployments need trustworthy, recoverable upgrades without mixing application binaries, customer data and service ownership.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the full-SHA resolution, explicit noninteractive consent, isolated build env, verified store, service fail-closed behavior and data-preserving uninstall. Add signed digests/SBOM/license/vulnerability gates, sandboxed builds, redacted stderr, migration compatibility, post-switch health and automatic rollback.
units.responsibilityConflict: --yes authorizes source installation but does not bind an accountable operator to exact package digests, migrations, service changes and resulting evidence.

units.function: Filesystem tests for install manifest/current/shim/RC durability, retention, locking, provenance and link/path defenses.
units.dependencyDirection: Exercises production install-store primitives directly against cleaned temporary roots.
units.keyDataModels: Private install manifest, current symlink, two previous records, store/managed markers, mutation lock, shim and shell PATH block.
units.lifecycle: Writes/reads state, simulates pre-rename crash, retains/prunes versions, mutates shim/RC, recovers stale lock and rejects unsafe links/ownership.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 9/11 and failed 2/11 on Node 24/macOS. One failure proves implementation cleanup masks the intended crash; the other is test cleanup using rmSync on a directory symlink. Remaining coverage is unusually strong but portability is not green.
units.designRationale: Make local upgrades atomic, reversible and safe against accidental or link-based filesystem damage.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs cross-platform verified upgrade state and rollback for local enterprise installations.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT after fixing symlink cleanup portably and making the suite green on supported Node/platform matrices. Add manifest/current transaction recovery, fsync/failure injection, signed content provenance, corrupted-state recovery and post-upgrade service/database health rollback.
units.responsibilityConflict: Install history is provenance metadata, not an accountable change record; it lacks operator, approved artifact digest, migration effect and verification evidence.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 9 passed, 2 failed on Node 24/macOS

units.function: Managed-install persistence and filesystem safety implementation for markers, lock, manifest, current payload, pruning, shim and shell PATH integration.
units.dependencyDirection: Depends only on Node filesystem/path and home resolution; higher install/service orchestration consumes it.
units.keyDataModels: InstallRecord/Manifest, trusted store paths, marker grammar, hard-link lock token, current relative symlink and exact managed shim/PATH block.
units.lifecycle: Initializes/verifies private store, serializes mutation, validates payload, flips current, records history, prunes, writes/removes shim and RC block, and validates executable provenance.
units.testAssessment: Implementation is well-structured and heavily tested, but current tests expose a real Node 24/macOS cleanup defect and a test portability defect. fsync, multi-file transaction recovery, corrupted manifest, post-switch health and supply-chain integrity remain gaps.
units.designRationale: Keep executable updates separate from instance data and fail closed around filesystem ambiguity or ownership conflicts.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS local enterprise profile requires data-preserving, auditable and rollback-capable upgrades across macOS/Linux and eventually Windows/container packaging.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT rather than copy unchanged. Preserve private verified roots, exact markers, containment, atomic current, bounded history and user-data separation; fix directory-symlink cleanup, validate full manifest/digests, fsync state, recover current/manifest mismatches and bind service/database health to rollback.
units.responsibilityConflict: The store knows artifact source/time but not the accountable operator, approval scope, exact content digest/license, migration effects or verification evidence.
evidence: install-store focused Vitest exposed flipCurrentAtomic finally cleanup defect on Node 24/macOS
